method: In-memory transform over the unchanged current graph with only its latest version label set to the intended baseline 1.161. This is isolated schema/preservation validation, not final chain reconstruction.
checks: Existing edges and source records byte-equivalent as parsed values
Existing people fields preserved; node_id added only
Prior roster role/context/works/basis and source IDs preserved
Each person has at least two relationships and three contribution events
No person coverage/date_span or inferred activity intervals
Hartman/Fuentes project influence has independent date/coeditor metadata plus Fuentes’s explicit inspiration statement
